definitions.explanation: Speaking or performing spontaneously without preparation or a script. Common in music, comedy, and acting.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦シーン→シーン：08914_shiin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧アドリブ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{演|えん}じた→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧。
⟦ジャズ→ジャズ：07084_jazu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧アドリブ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
アドリブ refers to spontaneous, unscripted performance or speech. Borrowed from Latin "ad libitum" (at pleasure), via English.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- アドリブ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧: to perform ad-lib
- アドリブ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧: to be good at improvising
- アドリブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to throw in an ad-lib
- アドリブ⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧: improvised performance

USAGE:
Most commonly heard in entertainment contexts: ⟦ジャズ→ジャズ：07084_jazu⟧ improvisation, comedy (⟦{漫才|まんざい}→漫才：04458_manzai⟧, variety shows), theater, and film. Also used more broadly for any unscripted speaking, such as presentations or interviews. As a な-adjective: アドリブな⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ (an improvised response).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{即興|そっきょう}→即興：06989_sokkyou⟧: improvisation (more formal/literary, used in music and art)
- ⟦{台本|だいほん}→台本：11868_daihon⟧なし: without a script (descriptive phrase)
